reason.viewOnly: You can view the team. Inviting needs the team:invite permission and changing roles needs team:manage.

reason.viewOnlyAsk.note: helpers: names joined as 'A, B or C'

grant.owner: Only a transfer of ownership makes someone the Owner.

invite.ownScope: You can only invite people within your own scope.

role.unknown: That role doesn't exist in this workspace.
problem.lastOwner: {name} is the last Owner. A workspace always keeps at least one Owner, so this role can't be changed and the member can't be removed or deactivated. Transfer ownership to another member first.

problem.outrank.message: You can't change {name}'s access: their role holds {permissions}, which you don't.
problem.outrank.note: permissions: keys such as team:manage, joined with commas

problem.ownerOnly: Only an Owner can make someone an Owner. Use Transfer ownership in Settings › General.
problem.ownerTwoFactor: {name} needs two-factor before becoming an Owner.
problem.scopeWithin: You can only give a scope within your own.
problem.language: Pick a language ReputeCast is translated into.
problem.oldInvite: This invitation was created before links could be copied. Resend it to get a new link.
problem.tooMany: Invite up to 50 people at a time.

problem.deactivateSelf.message: You can't deactivate yourself. Ask another member with team:manage, or leave the workspace from Account & security.
problem.deactivateSelf.note: team:manage is a permission key, never translated

problem.accountDeactivated: {name}'s account is deactivated on this instance. Ask an instance admin to reactivate the account first.
problem.removeSelf: You can't remove yourself. Leave the workspace from Account & security instead.
